name: bump-version
title_zh: 一次改完版本号，七处文件不再漏
tagline_zh: 发版前总在 manifest、UI 常量、更新日志、商店描述之间来回翻找？
tagline_en: Tired of hunting through manifest, UI constants, changelogs, and store listings before each release? This skill.
desc_en: Use when preparing a PlainTab release or bumping the PlainTab version, triggered by phrases like "更新版本", "bump version", "upgrade to vX.Y.Z", "发布新版本". Updates manifest.json, runtime UI/version constants, localized changelogs, store listings, release notes, validation notes, and current project docs.
why_zh: 不是简单替换字符串，而是按 PlainTab 发版流程逐项核对：manifest、运行时 UI。
why_en: It follows PlainTab's actual release checklist—manifest, runtime UI, i18n changelogs, store pages, release notes, validation.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 PlainTab 项目结构，且仓库需已克隆到本地。只处理版本号相关字段，不负责构建产物、签名或上传发布。
limit_en: PlainTab repo only, must be cloned locally. Touches version fields exclusively—no builds, signing, or publishing. Non-default project layout needs.
title_en: Bump PlainTab version across all 7 file locations at once
